name: marketplace_1
description: VolunteerMatch is a platform connecting volunteers with nonprofit volunteer opportunities. Core entities include volunteer profiles, organizations, opportunities, applications, shifts, and skills. Nonprofits create organization profiles and post volunteer opportunities specifying roles, required skills, time commitment, location or virtual status, and schedules. They can define shifts with dates, times, and capacity per shift. Volunteers create profiles with interests, skills, availability, and preferred causes, and can search and apply to opportunities. Applications can be accepted, rejected, or waitlisted, and applicants receive status updates. Opportunity owners manage rosters per shift, track attendance, and log volunteer hours. Volunteers can update their availability, confirm shift attendance, and maintain a historical record of hours served, downloadable as a report. Messaging workflows support communication between organizations and applicants, including automated reminders for upcoming shifts and thank-you messages after completed service.

name: booking_marketplace_1
description: Airbnb is a marketplace for short-term stays and experiences. Guests can search and filter listings by location, dates, price, property type, and amenities, then view detailed pages with photos, descriptions, house rules, and reviews. They submit booking requests or use instant book, manage trips, send messages to hosts, and handle cancellations or changes. Hosts can create and edit listings, set pricing and availability, manage calendars, respond to inquiries, and review guests. The platform manages payments, identity checks, and dispute resolution.

name: booking_and_appointments_1
description: ZenTime Wellness Scheduler is a booking and appointment management platform for spas, massage therapists, and wellness studios. Key entities include locations, treatment rooms, services, service categories, staff profiles, working hours, appointments, and client records. Admins can CRUD services with durations, prices, required resources (room, equipment), and staff eligibility. Staff schedules capture recurring availability, breaks, and blackout dates. Clients create accounts with contact info, preferences, and consent forms stored as versioned records. Booking workflows query availability by date, service, and staff, then create appointment records with status (pending, confirmed, checked-in, completed, no-show, canceled) and payment state. The system supports add-ons, package deals, and gift cards as separate entities linked to appointments. Automated rules handle double-booking checks and room allocation. Clients can reschedule or cancel within policy thresholds, and staff can update SOAP notes or visit notes per appointment. APIs expose endpoints for CRUD on clients, services, schedules, and appointments, making it ideal for synthetic test data such as simulated daily schedules, cancellations, and utilization reports.
